# Matched ablation pairs, development set (generated by scripts/audit_v2/ablation_pairs.py)

817 dev instances (train+val), seed 0, T = 300 s. 'Δ PAR2' = 1 − PAR2(second)/PAR2(first), positive = second configuration better, 95% family-group cluster bootstrap CI (10,000). SAT/UNSAT = post-hoc observed answers (235 SAT, 192 UNSAT, the rest unsolved by every configuration); descriptive only.

| first → second | single factor changed | Δ PAR2 % [CI] | Δ solved SAT | Δ solved UNSAT |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| D (stock) → I− (init neg.) | phase option 1→0 only: saved initial sign, fallback sign and the direction of 'original'/'inverted' rephasing (rephase, target unchanged) | +2.7 [+0.3, +5.6] | +11 | +3 |
| D (stock) → D/no-R | rephase 1→0 only: no rephasing and therefore no rephase-triggered local search (walk) or warmup; target phases unchanged | -10.0 [-21.7, -2.0] | -61 | +11 |
| D/no-R → I−/no-R | phase option 1→0 with rephasing off: saved initial sign and fallback only | +2.9 [-0.4, +7.3] | +17 | -1 |
| I−/no-R → F− (forced neg.) | forcephase 0→1 (rephase already off in both, negative initial phase in both): free decisions use the forced negative sign instead of target/saved phases; also likely_phase (clause layout in garbage collection) | -3.8 [-7.7, +0.2] | -10 | -14 |
| I−/no-R → S (pure saved) | target 1→0 only (rephase off, negative initial phase): stable-mode decisions use saved instead of target phases | -2.1 [-7.3, +1.2] | -18 | +8 |
| D (stock) → P− (decision-only neg.) | track P: free decisions forced negative, everything else native (rephasing and walk still run but cannot influence free decisions) | -11.6 [-21.7, -5.3] | -52 | -9 |
| F+ (forced pos.) → F− (forced neg.) | sign of the forced phase (both force and disable rephasing); interacts with the encoding | +2.1 [-3.6, +9.5] | +18 | -5 |
| P− (decision-only neg.) → F− (forced neg.) | decision-only negative vs forcephase negative: F− additionally disables rephasing/walk, initialises saved negative and changes likely_phase | +0.7 [-0.5, +1.9] | -2 | +5 |

Path reading (not a unique decomposition; interactions were not tested): D → D/no-R → I−/no-R → F− changes SAT solved by the amounts in rows 2, 3 and 4; the order of steps is a choice, and other orders (e.g. D → I− first) give other per-step attributions.
